selection.quantity: float64(QICE)*float64(den)/(nominal ice cap*nominal maximum ice mean mass)
selection.first_infeasible: first lexicographic z,y,x with ratio > 1; QNICE is zero at the selected B1 cell, while QICE is positive

derived.DELZ: diff(float32(PH+PHB))/float32(9.81 m s-2); file-state layer thickness m; 40 staggered geopotential values retained
derived.den: float32(1 / float32(AL + ALB)); kg m-3, file-state dry density proxy
derived.dry_tk: float32(T+300) * (float32(P+PB)/100000)**(float32(287.0)/float32(1004.5)); K, dry Exner file-state proxy
derived.NI_nominal_maximum_mass_kg-1: QICE / policy.upper[1]; nominal lambda_min maximum-mass candidate, can exceed entry cap
derived.NI_fixed_50um_kg-1: QICE / (pi*500/6*(50e-6)**3); fixed 50 micrometre, 500 kg m-3 ice sphere
derived.native_constants: nominal policy values are not source-real32 native constants; native replay must seed with its own pinned constants

scope: File-state inputs and proxies, not established first-use microphysics state. No input NetCDF modified.
